The year '''2021''' was the fourth year in the history of the [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship]], a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] promotion based in [[Philadelphia]]. The year consisted of 13 events, including an inaugural Fight Night event alongside nine title fights.<ref name=mymma21 /> The promotion also saw the inception of the new [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Cruiserweight Championship|Cruiserweight division]] and its inaugural title fight at [[#BKFC_18:_Beltran_vs._Shewmaker|BKFC 18]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2021/06/bkfc-18-pearl-gonzalez-bareknuckle-debut-vs-charisa-sigala|title=Pearl Gonzalez books bareknuckle debut, meets Charisa Sigala at BKFC 18|date=June 1, 2021|work=[[MMAjunkie.com]]|author=Nolan King}}</ref>

== Background ==
2021 season is expected to start with Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship: KnuckleMania. BKFC is available on PPV all over the world and on [[FITE TV]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/FiteTV/status/1337579280381915136|title=Who is ready for the bareknucklefc debut of paige vanzant?|publisher=twitter.com/FiteTV/}}</ref>

==BKFC 2021 Awards==
The following fighters won the BKFC year-end awards for 2022
* '''BKFC Fighter of the Year 2022:''' [[Luis Palomino]]
* '''BKFC Female Fighter of the Year 2022:''' [[Britain Hart]]
* '''BKFC Fight of the Year 2022:''' Taylor Starling vs. Charisa Sigala {{small|'''([[#Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship: KnuckleMania|BKFC: KnuckleMania]])'''}}
* '''BKFC Knockout of the Year 2022:''' [[Joe Riggs]] over [[Melvin Guillard]] {{small|'''([[#Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship Fight Night: Montana|BKFC FN: Montana]])'''}}

'''''BKFC KnuckleMania''''' was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on February 5, 2021, in [[Miami]], [[United States|USA]].

===Background===
Former UFC star [[Paige VanZant]] made her [[bare-knuckle fighting]] debut in the main event.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bjpenn.com/bare-knuckle-boxing/paige-vanzant-will-make-her-bkfc-debut-on-superbowl-weekend-against-britain-hart/|title=Paige VanZant will make her BKFC debut on SuperBowl weekend|publisher=bjpenn.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.essentiallysports.com/ufc-mma-news-paige-vanzant-keen-to-fight-britain-hart-on-her-bkfc-debut/|title=Paige VanZant Keen to Fight Britain Hart on Her BKFC Debut|date=15 November 2020 |publisher=essentiallysports.com}}</ref>

[[Chris Leben]] made his combat sports retirement appearance against Quentin Henry.<ref name=mmaf21>{{cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2021/1/7/22219112/bkfc-announces-knucklemania-ppv-on-super-bowl-weekend-featuring-paige-vanzant-vs-britain-hart|title=BKFC announces 'Knucklemania' PPV on Super Bowl weekend featuring Paige VanZant vs. Britain Hart|author=Steven Marrocco|date=January 7, 2021|publisher=mmafighting.com}}</ref>

Uly Diaz was initially scheduled to compete on the card, but was eventually removed from the card due to an unknown reason.<ref name=mmaf21 /><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/2021/2/3/22264129/bareknuckle-16-fight-card-ppv-lineup-knucklemania-paige-vanzant-debut-chris-leben-fitetv-boxing|title=Latest BKFC 16 fight card, PPV lineup for 'Knucklemania' on Feb. 5 — VanZant vs Hart|author=Thomas Myers|date=February 3, 2021|publisher=mmamania.com}}</ref>

The following fighters were awarded bonuses:
* '''Fight of the Night:''' Taylor Starling vs. Charisa Sigala<ref>{{cite instagram|postid=CLH8-ktJuDk|user=bareknucklefc|date=February 10, 2021|title=The UNREAL FOTN! @taywstarling and @charisa_sweetheart}}</ref>

'''''BKFC Thailand 1: The Game Changer''''' was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship held on December 18, 2021, in [[Thailand]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=THAITICKETMAJOR|title=Official Ticket {{!}} BKFC THAILAND|url=https://www.thaiticketmajor.com/sport/bkfc-thailand-2021.html|access-date=2021-12-03|website=THAITICKETMAJOR|language=en}}</ref>

=== Background ===
In the main event, Tee Jay Chang and Fabiano Hawthorne and in the co-main event, [[Sirimongkol Singmanasak]] and Reza Goodary will face each other.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-11-29|title=The first appearance of an Iranian in BKFC|url=https://www.yjc.ir/fa/news/7982236/%D9%86%D8%AE%D8%B3%D8%AA%DB%8C%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%B6%D9%88%D8%B1-%DB%8C%DA%A9-%D8%A7%DB%8C%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%DB%8C-%D8%AF%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%AA%E2%80%8C%D9%87%D8%A7%DB%8C-%D8%A8%D9%88%DA%A9%D8%B3-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%81%D9%87%E2%80%8C%D8%A7%DB%8C|access-date=2021-12-03|website=YJC|language=fa}}</ref> Hawthorne later withdrew due to injury and was replaced by Keivan Soleimani.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/bkfcthailand/photos/a.105311998645937/122172303626573/|title=OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT|website=Facebook|date=2021-12-13|access-date=2021-12-14}}</ref>
